where.if: AND (f.address LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR f.information LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.sql: f.af_id id,f.tel_id supervisorId,u.real_name supervisorName, f.province_id provinceId,p.province_name provinceName,f.city_id cityId,c.city_name cityName, f.address,f.information,f.estimated_grade estimatedGrade, f.gm_id gridMemberId,g.gm_name gridMemberName,f.state, f.submitted_at submittedAt,f.assigned_at assignedAt,f.confirmed_at confirmedAt, s.so2_value so2,s.co_value co,s.spm_value pm25, s.so2_level so2Level,s.co_level coLevel,s.spm_level pm25Level,s.aqi_id actualGrade

FROM aqi_feedback f JOIN supervisor u ON u.tel_id=f.tel_id JOIN grid_province p ON p.province_id=f.province_id JOIN grid_city c ON c.city_id=f.city_id LEFT JOIN grid_member g ON g.gm_id=f.gm_id LEFT JOIN statistics s ON s.feedback_id=f.af_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY f.submitted_at DESC,f.af_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) total,COALESCE(SUM(aqi_id<=2),0) good,COALESCE(SUM(aqi_id>=3),0) polluted, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aqi_feedback WHERE state=0) pending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aqi_feedback WHERE state=1) assigned, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aqi_feedback) feedbackTotal, COUNT(DISTINCT f.province_id) coveredProvinces,COUNT(DISTINCT f.city_id) coveredCities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM grid_province) provinceTotal,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM grid_city) cityTotal FROM statistics s JOIN aqi_feedback f ON f.af_id=s.feedback_id
SELECT a.aqi_id grade,a.aqi_explain name,a.color,COUNT(s.id) count FROM aqi a LEFT JOIN statistics s ON s.aqi_id=a.aqi_id GROUP BY a.aqi_id,a.aqi_explain,a.color ORDER BY a.aqi_id

SELECT p.province_id id,p.province_name name,p.province_abbr abbr,COUNT(s.id) total, COALESCE(SUM(s.aqi_id>=3),0) polluted,COALESCE(SUM(s.so2_level>=3),0) so2, COALESCE(SUM(s.co_level>=3),0) co,COALESCE(SUM(s.spm_level>=3),0) pm25 FROM grid_province p LEFT JOIN aqi_feedback f ON f.province_id=p.province_id LEFT JOIN statistics s ON s.feedback_id=f.af_id GROUP BY p.province_id,p.province_name,p.province_abbr ORDER BY p.province_id
